name: The Devil
source: Potato Desk 09 Hell Reviews, storyboards/series/potato-desk/09-hell-reviews/DESIGN.md section 1 (19 Nov 2026) and the panel sheet v1
personality: The vain resort host of Hell (Potato Desk 09): a bright, quick game-show host who is always smiling and always the authority, until a 5-star review is on the line. A red potato: chit horns, a root-runner tail, one loud teal flame-flower shirt, a gold badge with one star.
voiceNote: gibberish, warm bright game-show host (a proposal until Jonny has heard it); 'Want to try again?' at half volume, slower
notes: Standing 1.06 m (horn tips 1.20). Costume keys (shirt, badge, hornLen, tailLen, tailDroop, tailFlick, colours) are documented in the header of engine/page/costumes-devil.js. Skin dimples and freckles are drawn by that kit (the body's own specks are off). No leaf: the horns are chits. Tail droop: costume.tailDroop (number or keyframes) or the timeline action droop.
